name: 二枚の写真アルバム
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup / precise-object-edit. ONE Lighthouse component LH03-0008「二枚の写真アルバム」.
Reference hierarchy: ORIGINAL Image1 is PRIMARY for photograph composition/crops, upload-stop glyph geometry, ring thickness, status-clock anatomy and small spacing. Image2 mock is SECONDARY for logical390x330 layout and localized time only. Do NOT copy its incorrect double-check status or rough hollow stop square. Images3 and4 are retained crops of the actual original photographs, to preserve faithfully. Image5 style only.
One outgoing chat album card on a pure-white canvas, logical292x314px, positioned as in mock within390x330. Two wide photographs vertically stacked with a narrow white gutter: EXACT original red apple covered in water drops on pale background, then EXACT original light-blue cup/saucer with heart latte art against warm brown background. Preserve original photos' content, colors, focal point, aspect and crop; do not replace with a different apple, change droplets, change latte art/cup/handle, move camera or invent new imagery. Use source media as fixed photographic inserts.
White rounded album surface, quiet neutral border, tiny restrained green edge/tail to indicate outgoing direction rather than mint fill; gentle soft shadow. The original pale green identifies outgoing message direction, which is adapted to the thin edge. Keep photograph colors unchanged, not recolored to green.
At the seam, ONE round upload-stop control as in ORIGINAL: white/light-neutral circle, thin slate progress/outline ring, small FILLED slate stop square centered. Keep the original control's proportions and placement. Crop images3/4 contain portions of the original control at their edge; combine/mask them into this ONE coherent common control, do not duplicate extra halves or add another stop icon.
Bottom right of white footer: exact time「11:05」in Meiryo Regular12px/16px at logical size, tracking0, muted slate, followed by the small ORIGINAL PENDING CLOCK icon. Source is sending in progress; no single or double check, no success check, no invented progress value. Mock double-check incorrectly implies delivered/read.
Output square1:1, ONE complete readable album centered with modest white margins. No header, conversation, wallpaper, device, external share control (outside selected region), labels, titles or extra photographs. Inspectable complete media and accurate sending controls, compact hierarchy. Preserve uploaded source photo evidence; this raster remains only a design candidate.
reviewNotes: 全原画像と2枚の切り抜きを実入力して目視。写真2枚、単一の塗り停止四角、11:05と送信中時計へ修正できた。ただし外周が明るい黄緑で公式森林緑に合わず、時計の外形も原画像の角丸四角から丸へ一般化。写真内容は同じ構図だが画素同一性は未検証。要修正で保存。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
